name: verve-store
description: Verve — a full-stack online clothing store (React + Vite frontend, Express + Prisma backend).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix server run db:setup
scripts.build: npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix server run db:setup
